metadata.scenario: An automated robocall about extending the office's car warranty. The receptionist listens for a few seconds, realizes it's spam, and hangs up. Very short call.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, this is Charles Thompson. I'm a client for post-surgical wound care. Hi, Charles! It's great to hear from you. How can I assist you? I just wanted to check in. I had a nurse visit two days ago, and... Oh, wait, hold on a second. Sure, no problem. *sighs* This is a robocall. Is everything okay? Yeah, it's just spam. Let me hang up. Alright then. Back to you, Charles. What were you saying? I wanted to talk about the progress on my wound care. Of course! I can also arrange for a male nurse for your next visit, if you prefer. That would be great, thank you. I'll make a note of that. And would you like a detailed progress report for the VA? Yes, please. That would help a lot. I'll ensure that’s prepared after your next visit. Perfect. When will I have my next nurse visit? I can schedule that for early next week. Does Monday work for you? Yes, that sounds good. Great! I’ll confirm that with you via text. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help! You're welcome, Charles! If you think of anything else, don’t hesitate to call. Will do! Talk to you soon. Bye! Bye!
